plan.authorization: 2026-11-01 user request for deeper research and improved controlled local experiments
plan.purpose: Paired finite backbone screen: can longer vector returns improve task expression before allocation research?
plan.allocation: uniform shared protocol-seeded 32-preference pool; episode-fixed behavior preference and head

screen_gate.checkpoint: final only; intermediate checkpoints describe trajectories, never select a best model
screen_gate.lunar: each training seed: at least 8/10 native +100 AND pad-x outcomes at landing-heavy preference
screen_gate.minecart: each training seed: at least 5/10 positive ore deliveries at [0.45,0.45,0.1]
screen_gate.effect: Report paired seed-level utility differences and all individual seed outcomes; 3 pairs are a feasibility screen, not a significance claim

limitations: n=20 is an explicit unvalidated hypothesis, not a Minecart paper default
Uncorrected off-policy multi-step targets may introduce bias
Both arms receive the same longer budget; historical cohorts are not matched controls
No change to frozen gamma, scale, reference point, final-test split or historical unlock gates
plan.stop_rule: Exactly 12 jobs. No seed replacement, outcome-based extension, checkpoint cherry-picking, or automatic final-test unlock. Technical failures remain recorded.

recovery_amendment.authorization: User authorized durable-launch, exact-resume qualification and recovery on 2026-11-01 after reviewing the interruption
recovery_amendment.interrupted_original_compute: At least 925000 recorded interactions, at most 999997 before next 25k progress flush, plus separately retained evaluation work; never relabel as exact continuation
recovery_amendment.restart_policy: Exactly the three interrupted jobs restart from their original seeds in new directories; three completed originals are retained; six unstarted jobs run unchanged. No seed replacement or outcome-based extension.
recovery_amendment.learner_changes: None intended. Same parent plan, architecture, optimizer, RNG draw sequence, n-step targets, budgets, checkpoints and evaluation cases. Old/new numerical compatibility required for both environments and both arms.
recovery_amendment.checkpoint_policy: Atomic two-generation, checksum-bound recovery snapshots at the first completed episode after each 10k interval; save replay, target, optimizer, all RNGs, sampler, counters, histories, next episode reconstruction. Abrupt loss may replay the tail since the last boundary; record process segments separately.
recovery_amendment.launch_policy: Hidden independent Windows process; OS-held byte leases prevent duplicate coordinator/workers; heartbeat plus PID/creation time distinguish pending/running/stopped; no scheduled dispatch or automatic training retries
recovery_amendment.qualification: Old/new same-seed numerical equality for both environments and n=1/20; uninterrupted versus fresh-process killed/resumed equality; active duplicate rejected; worker survives launching shell termination
recovery_amendment.scientific_gates: Original failed matrix/F1/final-test locks remain unchanged. Complete execution does not imply task success.
